portfolioItems.title: PromoZon
portfolioItems.shortDescription: Realtime Location Based Deals Notifying Application.

introduction.text: We had the privilege of collaborating with PromoZon, a UK 🇬🇧-based startup. PromoZon aims to revolutionise the customer-merchant relationship in the digital age. We developed two native mobile apps, one for customers and one for merchants, available on both iOS and Android devices. PromoZon represents a successful collaboration that integrates cutting-edge technology, native mobile development, and geolocation precision to deliver a unique and highly interactive shopping experience. It's the ultimate tool for both customers seeking great deals and merchants looking to boost their business.

items.title: Personalised Deal Notifications
items.description: PromoZon offers users tailored deal alerts based on their location and preferences, ensuring they never miss out on exciting offers.

items.title: Dual Native Mobile Applications
items.description: Customers and merchants enjoy a seamless experience with PromoZon's iOS and Android applications, designed to optimize performance on each platform.

items.title: Messaging
items.description: The app enables direct messaging between customers and merchants, fostering instant interactions and query resolutions.

items.title: QR Code Redemption
items.description: Customers can effortlessly redeem their selected deals by presenting unique QR codes generated by the app at the cashier's desk, streamlining the checkout process.

items.title: Loyalty Program
items.description: PromoZon rewards customers with loyalty points for their active participation and provides a comprehensive wallet feature for tracking points and earning history.

portfolioItems.challenge:
Our collaboration with PromoZon presented multifaceted challenges. One key hurdle was developing a location-based mobile app that seamlessly served personalised deal notifications. Handling the intricacies of geolocation and ensuring a smooth user experience was a considerable task.

Crafting a dual mobile app for both iOS and Android platforms added another layer of complexity. Meeting the distinct requirements of these platforms required meticulous attention.

Additionally, facilitating efficient communication between customers and merchants, including real-time notifications, robust messaging, and reporting mechanisms, was a significant undertaking.
portfolioItems.solution:
Our team adopted a multi-pronged approach. Leveraging native development ensured that PromoZon's apps operated efficiently on both iOS and Android devices.

Geo-location challenges were met with innovative solutions, resulting in precise location tracking and real-time notifications. We integrated QR code technology for secure deal redemption. Our solution also featured a comprehensive messaging system for merchants and customers, enhancing communication and collaboration.

Dealing with the complex customer-merchant ecosystem, we implemented robust backend solutions for data management, enhancing the performance and reliability of the application. Additionally, a comprehensive reporting system was developed, allowing users to report concerns or issues with ease.

In developing the PromoZon project, our team navigated through these challenges with a combination of technical expertise and innovative solutions.
